title: Unit Review: Verbs of Change and Lillo
goal: Review the verbs of change through a retelling of a story by Baldomero Lillo.
grammar: review of the verbs of change and a retelling of a story by Baldomero Lillo

items: I can read a short retelling of a story by Baldomero Lillo and notice the verbs of change in it.
I can use *ponerse*, *quedarse*, *volverse*, *hacerse*, *convertirse en* and *llegar a ser* for different kinds of change.
I can choose the verb that fits the kind of change.
